_comment: Chapter VI room by room, in play order (docs/CHAPTER6.md §1). Not a generator table yet: when a painting arrives, its row moves into tools/rooms/painted_rooms.py and the scene is generated. validate_data.gd checks every id named here.

rooms.note: Storm over the river; the mighty angel is painted in the depth (camera to [640, 230]). The river at the bottom right is water to swim in, not a fall.
A feast in the street; the two witnesses lie on the cobbles in the middle; the scarred man walks off right at the back.
The abbey gate; the roll of the chain-keepers behind a bricked-up guardroom on the upper ledge. Fork after: cloister / scriptorium.
Open gallery round a garden. No story here.
Close, shelves in three tiers, a chained copyist at his ring. No story here.
The long table laid for forty; Saul by the bread oven (the rest point). The censer monk is down in the cellar, left third.
Composed 1x2 (tools/rooms/composed_rooms.json, live). The sealed page under the bells on the upper screen.
The golden altar with four horns in the centre; the lion-headed horse wakes by it after the scene. Fork after: crypt / cistern.
A forest of chains: seven rings. No story here.
Deep water under vaults. No story here.
The stair down into the riverbed; the shrine niche on the middle landing is the rest point; the novice's letter in a niche beside it.
The dry riverbed: four pillars of stone and gold (bound_phases.anchors), shallow pools that slow.
